goals.title: Accessible dependency map
goals.goal: Create an accessible interactive outline explaining the internal connections needed to turn a local civic concern into responsible next steps, clearly labeling uncertain or unverified links. No external network requests.

goals.title: Interactive local progress checklist
goals.goal: Create a keyboard-accessible checklist for generic source-review steps. Keep selections only in current page memory, never store private information or imply official source validation.

goals.title: Explain evidence quality
goals.goal: Create a compact expandable explanation of candidate versus reviewed versus verified evidence, with accessible buttons and explicit warnings that URL reachability is not factual verification.

goals.title: Civic issue pathway explorer
goals.goal: Present an interactive illustrative pathway from issue description to finding a trustworthy source and then independently contacting the correct official site. No actual form submission or fabricated responsibility.
